capabilities: Record from a main microphone plus optional additional audio inputs
Transcribe audio live and write transcript updates during recording
Generate a summary note after the recording stops
Store sessions with audio, transcript, summary, and diagnostics
Preview, recover, clean up, and bulk-delete session artifacts in a library
extras: Desktop-only; the README documents manual installation steps (npm run build and copying dist files) and includes a Common Failures troubleshooting section with symptoms and fixes.
problem: Obsidian's core Audio recorder only records audio files; it does not transcribe speech or produce summary notes from recordings.

relations.evidence: Ollama or an optional cloud provider for summaries

requires.name: whisper.cpp with a local ggml model

summary: Local-first AI recorder that captures microphone audio, transcribes live with whisper.cpp, generates summaries with Ollama or cloud providers, and stores sessions in a library.
